headline: HuyenBao v13.10 — Collapsible assets + thousand separators + market redesign + items in DB
summary: v13.10: Assets owned items collapsible by category. Thousand separators (fmtFull) in all tables. Market tab redesigned with stock cards. Items moved to SQLite database for admin management. Version notification system fixed.
features: Assets: owned items collapsed by 12 categories (tap to expand)
fmtFull(): thousand-separated numbers ($100,000,000) in all tables
Market tab: stock cards with sparkline + portfolio info
Items in SQLite database (admin can edit ALL items)
Public /api/items route for client to fetch DB items
